Researcher finds zero-day that hands attackers control of Meta's Muse

Patrick Wardle said any local app can steal the token that controls a Muse account. Meta did not answer questions from Ars Technica.

https://theaipost.net/story/muse-zero-day-wardle/

Alibaba plans model of 5 to 10 trillion parameters, launches AI chip

Chief executive Eddie Wu set out the plan at Alibaba Cloud's Apsara Conference in Hangzhou, alongside a new accelerator and a 20 gigawatt data centre target.

https://theaipost.net/story/alibaba-apsara-v900/

British Columbia sues OpenAI, says warning could have averted shooting

The province filed in California on Monday, arguing the company should have told police what it knew about a user before a mass shooting at a school.

https://theaipost.net/story/bc-openai-duty-to-warn/

Artificial Analysis puts Gemini 3.1 Flash top of new speech benchmark

The evaluator's new pronunciation test measures how often text-to-speech models read difficult text correctly, and puts Google's entry at 88.1 percent.

https://theaipost.net/story/artificial-analysis-tts-pronunciation/

Artificial Analysis scores StepFun's Step 5 Preview at 44 on its index

The evaluator said the model matches Kimi K3 at about a third of the cost per task, but trails rivals on agentic work.

https://theaipost.net/story/step5-artificial-analysis/

Microsoft doubles Taiwan AI data centre plan to 4 sites, manager says

Bian Zhixiang also said Microsoft's own AI chips should reach mass production in 2027, in remarks reported by Economic Daily News.

https://theaipost.net/story/microsoft-taiwan-datacentres/

LG, Microsoft agree to explore data centre cooling deal, newspaper says

Chairman Koo Kwang-mo met Satya Nadella in Redmond, and the two companies will look at LG supplying power and cooling gear, the Seoul Economic Daily reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/lg-microsoft-cooling/

OpenAI is preparing always-on agent called Aeon, two accounts say

Neither account cites a document or an OpenAI statement, and the company has not confirmed that the agent exists.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-aeon-rumour/

Apple opens claims in $250 million settlement over AI Siri delay

US owners of the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 have until 21 December to file, with an estimated $25 per device.

https://theaipost.net/story/apple-siri-settlement-claims/
